newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: RESEARCH ALERT - Merrill says EDP overvalued.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Merrill says EDP overvalued.

text.p: Merrill Lynch recommended clients reduce their holdings in Portuguese state-controlled utility EDP-Electricidade de Portugal saying that the company was "sound but overvalued."

"Our initial opinion is reduce, with an expectation that the shares will move below our 12-month price objective of 3,000 escudos," the investment house said in a client advisory, a copy of which was obtained by Reuters.
EDP was trading 0.54 percent down at 3,105 escudos after word of the Merrill Lynch report got out. The stock was moving against the overall firmer trend of the Lisbon bourse.

Merrill Lynch said that current year earnings could disappoint due to currency losses and weak consumption trends, although the position would become clear after interim results are released in September.

On a price/earnings of 22 for estimated 1997 profits and earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortisation (EBITDA) of almost eight times, the stock looked vulnerable to this year's earnings coming in below consensus, Merrill Lynch said in the document .
"We view EDP as a sound company with attractive medium-term growth prospects, but overvalued," the investment firm said.
